findings.comment: Compliance (Important under REVIEW.md, 'Also say'): this PR brings the test count from 44 to 45, but CLAUDE.md > Verification still says healthy `bash scripts/check.sh` output ends with `ℹ tests 44` / `ℹ pass 44`. The run in the PR description already shows 45/45. Anyone or any agent comparing against CLAUDE.md will now see a mismatch on a healthy run. Update both lines to 45 in this PR.

Nit: the test only checks that a `dialog button:focus { ... outline: 2px solid` rule exists. It would still pass if a later rule in style.css overrides it, for example `dialog button:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none }`, which is a common reset. The PR already says it cannot reproduce Firefox's focus behaviour, so the real proof is still the manual T12 check in Firefox. A person should do that check before merging and note the result in review/1/PR.md, because the cause is marked 'probable, not confirmed'.
